params.name: resize
params.description: True if the form can be resized horizontally, False otherwise

params.name: minWidth
params.description: Smallest form width allowed, in pixels

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: Largest form width allowed, in pixels

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the current form's horizontal resizing properties (whether resizable, and the allowed min/max width in pixels).

constraints: These properties may have been set in the Form editor (Design mode) or previously in the current process via FORM SET HORIZONTAL RESIZING.
